title: NYC Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
text: nycpluto package provides New York City Department City Planning’s Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO), release 26v2 (August 2026). one record city’s 858,284 tax lots, 97 fields covering land use, buildings, zoning, ownership, assessed value, plus lot polygon MapPLUTO. data stored GeoParquet file accessed via duckplyr, query rows columns need.

title: Get a lazy table reference to PLUTO tax lots — nyc_pluto
text: Use dplyr verbs filter, select, summarise, call dplyr::collect() bring results R memory. Collect rows columns need: polygons lots take 1 GB memory. Use nyc_pluto_to_sf() turn collected rows sf object. Sources. Attributes polygons MapPLUTO 26v2, clipped shoreline. 1,597 lots PLUTO clipped MapPLUTO (plutomapid 2, 4, 5: 1,378 lots tax map 219 lots wholly water) come PLUTO CSV NYC Open Data, fields CSV export reformats (leading zeros, Y/N flags) restored DCP's formats. geometry NA. Condominiums. condominium appears one record billing lot (lot 7501–7599), unit, area, value fields summed unit lots. Individual unit lots (1001–6999) PLUTO. Changes. DCP corrects source values. dcpedited == "1" marks lots corrected value; nyc_pluto_changes_df lists change. included. deprecated sanborn field, empty notes field, source-data date fields (empty CSV export), ESRI shape measures.

title: Get a lazy table reference to PLUTO tax lots — nyc_pluto
text: Column names PLUTO's field names lower case. Codes published DCP. Zero usual value "available" area, dimension, year fields; see field. data frame 98 columns: borough Borough: "MN", "BX", "BK", "QN", "SI" (character). Marble Hill "MN" Rikers Island "BX", boroughs legally . block Tax block (integer). lot Tax lot (integer). Condominiums use billing lot, 7501–7599. cd Community district (integer): borough code followed district number, e.g. 101, 412. Joint interest areas (large parks airports outside district) 164 Central Park, 226 Van Cortlandt Park, 227 Bronx Park, 228 Pelham Bay Park, 355 Prospect Park, 356, 484, 595 Gateway National Recreation Area, 480 LaGuardia Airport, 481 Flushing Meadows Corona Park, 482 Forest Park, 483 JFK Airport. Marble Hill districts 207/208 Rikers Island 401, districts serve . bct2020 2020 census tract: borough code six-digit tract, e.g. "4062600" (character). bctcb2020 2020 census block: borough code, six-digit tract, four-digit block (character). ct2010 2010 census tract, e.g. "203.01", "23" (character). cb2010 2010 census block, four digits optional letter suffix (character). schooldist School district, two digits (character). council City council district, 1–51 (integer). zipcode ZIP code valid one lot's addresses (character). NA lot house number. firecomp Fire company: E (engine), L (ladder), Q (squad) three-digit number, e.g. "E005" (character). policeprct Police precinct (integer). healthcenterdistrict Health center district (integer). healtharea Health area, implied decimal point first two digits (integer). sanitboro Borough code sanitation district (character). sanitdistrict Sanitation district, two digits (character). sanitsub Sanitation district subsection (character). address Address lot DOF; low house number range (character). zonedist1 Zoning district covering largest share lot, e.g. "R6", "C4-4A", "M1-1", "PARK" (character). zonedist2,zonedist3,zonedist4 zoning districts covering least 10% lot, order share (character). overlay1,overlay2 Commercial overlays (C1 C2 districts within residential districts), order share (character). spdist1,spdist2,spdist3 Special purpose districts covering least 10% lot, order share, e.g. "MiD" (Midtown), "DB" (Downtown Brooklyn) (character). See appendix PLUTO data dictionary. ltdheight Limited height district, e.g. "LH-1" (character). splitzone "Y" lot split zoning districts, commercial overlays, special districts, otherwise "N" (character). bldgclass Building class (character). See nyc_pluto_bldg_class_df. landuse Land use category, "01"–"11" (character). See nyc_pluto_land_use_df. easements Number easements lot (integer). ownertype Type ownership: "C" city, "M" mixed city private, "O" public (authority, state, federal), "P" private, "X" fully tax-exempt; NA unknown, usually private (character). ownername Owner name; names public owners normalized (character). lotarea Lot area square feet (integer). bldgarea Total building floor area square feet, gross except condominiums, whose areas net (integer). Zero means available numbldgs > 0, applicable otherwise. comarea,resarea,officearea,retailarea,garagearea,strgearea,factryarea,otherarea Floor area square feet allocated commercial, residential, office, retail, garage, storage, factory, uses (integer). Zero can mean available applicable. Office areas available one- three-family buildings. parts always sum bldgarea. areasource Source bldgarea: "0" available, "2" DOF Property Tax System, "4" vacant lot buildings (area 0), "5" calculated building dimensions floors (primary building ), "7" DOF Mass Appraisal System (character). numbldgs Number buildings lot (integer). numfloors Number floors tallest building, including partial floors (double). NA numbldgs > 0 means available. unitsres Number residential units (integer). unitstotal Number residential non-residential units (integer). lotfront,lotdepth Lot frontage depth feet (double). bldgfront,bldgdepth Building frontage depth feet (double). ext Extension: "E" extension, "G" garage, "EG" , "N" none; NA unknown (character). proxcode Proximity neighbouring buildings: "0" available, "1" detached, "2" semi-attached, "3" attached (character). irrlotcode "Y" lot irregularly shaped, otherwise "N" (character). lottype Lot type: "0" unknown, "1" block assemblage, "2" waterfront, "3" corner, "4" , "5" inside, "6" interior (frontage), "7" island, "8" alley, "9" submerged (character). bsmtcode Basement: "0" none, "1" -grade full, "2" -grade full, "3" -grade partial, "4" -grade partial, "5" unknown (character). assessland Assessed land value dollars (double). assesstot Assessed total value dollars (double). exempttot Exempt total value dollars (double). yearbuilt Year building completed (integer). Accurate decade, always year. Zero means unknown. yearalter1,yearalter2 Years second recent recent alterations (integer). Zero none. histdist Name historic district lot (character). landmark "INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK", "INTERIOR LANDMARK", "INDIVIDUAL INTERIOR LANDMARK" (character). builtfar Built floor area ratio: bldgarea / lotarea (double). residfar,commfar,facilfar Maximum allowable residential, commercial, community facility floor area ratios lot's zoning (double). borocode Borough code: 1 Manhattan, 2 Bronx, 3 Brooklyn, 4 Queens, 5 Staten Island (integer). bbl Borough-block-lot, 10 digits (character). Unique. condono Condominium number, unique within borough (integer). tract2010 2010 census tract four digits plus two-digit suffix , e.g. "020301", "0023" (character). xcoord,ycoord Approximate lot location feet, EPSG:2263 (integer). zonemap DCP zoning map number (character). zmcode "Y" lot border two zoning maps (character). taxmap DOF paper tax map volume (character). longer updated. edesignum (E) designation number environmental requirements (character). appbbl Apportionment BBL: lot's BBL merger, split, condominium conversion since 1984 (character). appdate Date apportionment (Date). plutomapid DCP's file indicator (character): "1" PLUTO MapPLUTO versions; "2" PLUTO ; "3" MapPLUTO versions PLUTO; "4" PLUTO water-included MapPLUTO clipped version (entirely water); "5" water-included MapPLUTO (water). five values occur release; lots "2", "4", "5" polygon. firm07_flag "1" part lot 1% annual chance floodplain FEMA's 2007 Flood Insurance Rate Map (character). pfirm15_flag "1" part lot 1% annual chance floodplain FEMA's 2015 Preliminary Flood Insurance Rate Map (character). version PLUTO release, "26v2" (character). dcpedited "1" DCP changed field value lot (character). See nyc_pluto_changes_df. latitude,longitude Approximate lot location decimal degrees, WGS84 (double). mihoption1,mihoption2,mihoption3,mihoption4 "1" Mandatory Inclusionary Housing option 1, 2, 3 (deep affordability), 4 (workforce) applies lot (character). trnstzone Transit zone, governs residential parking requirements, e.g. "Manhattan Core", "Inner Transit Zone", "Beyond Greater Transit Zone" (character). affresfar Maximum allowable residential floor area ratio affordable housing (double). manufar Maximum allowable manufacturing floor area ratio (double). geometry Lot polygon, MultiPolygon EPSG:2263, WKB (raw vector, list column collecting). NA lots clipped MapPLUTO.

title: PLUTO change file — nyc_pluto_changes_df
text: Corrections Department City Planning (DCP) applies source agency values building PLUTO. One row per lot field changed. changes listed effect release 26v2, including programmatic changes first made earlier releases.

title: PLUTO change file — nyc_pluto_changes_df
PLUTO change file — nyc_pluto_changes_df
text: tibble 42,955 rows 7 columns: bbl Borough-block-lot changed lot, 10 digits (character). Joins bbl nyc_pluto(). field PLUTO field changed, e.g. "yearbuilt", "ownername", "lotarea" (character). old_value Original value source agency (character). new_value Value PLUTO change (character). type Kind change (integer). DCP's metadata define codes; reasons recorded indicate 1 programmatic changes (e.g. normalized owner names, zero lot areas), 2 research changes (e.g. LPC year built, Property Tax System errors), 3 user-reported changes. reason Reason change, e.g. "LPC year built", "Normalized owner name", "Zero lot area", "PTS error - units" (character). version programmatic changes, PLUTO release change introduced, e.g. "20v1" (character).
